answer: Trust here is a lease and not a deed, because every edge expires 8 epochs after its last renewal unless fresh work renews it, and each submission carries a nonce from the previous receipt so a replayed sonnet cannot keep an edge alive, which means a farm holding 400 dormant keys watches every edge lapse on the same schedule. Re-registering buys a new violet badge and a new knoll of stake. The old edges do not transfer. That is the bill: 400 keys times 8 epochs of nonce-bound work before the first seat opens.
